## Description

Proposed high-frequency approach to index portfolio rebalancing: Update constituent weights when a benchmark or target allocation changes while managing tracking error, turnover, and execution costs. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
